name: travel-journal
description: A travel journal web application that displays a personal collection of past travel destinations with photos, dates, descriptions, and map links.

paragraphs: A travel journal web application that displays a personal collection of past travel destinations with photos, dates, descriptions, and map links.

This project presents a personal journal of past travel destinations, with each trip displayed as an individual card containing a photo, location, travel dates, and a short description. It is built with React, JavaScript, and CSS, uses Vite as the build tool, and is deployed on Netlify for cloud hosting. Each card also includes a Google Maps link to the destination, and the most recently added trip appears first so the journal is organized from newest to oldest.
